settings.name: James T.
settings.title: Incredible detail for a 1:1 replica
settings.body: Ordered this as a surprise for my dad, a lifelong football fan. The size and finish are stunning, and engraving our family name on it made it really personal. It now has pride of place in his study.

settings.name: Daniel O.
settings.title: Exactly like the trophy on TV
settings.body: I was nervous ordering something this big online, but it arrived perfectly packed and looks identical to the cup I've seen lifted on TV. Communication throughout was excellent.

settings.hero_desc: A bold conceptual sculpture - a green alien posed as the Vitruvian figure inside a ring, marked with the Bitcoin symbol. A conversation-starting crypto art piece for offices, studios and collectors, finished on a clean display base.
settings.perso_placeholder: Your symbol or company logo at the center
settings.s1_body: This sculpture mashes up three ideas - the alien, the Vitruvian figure and the Bitcoin symbol - into one striking statement piece. It is the kind of object that anchors a crypto office, a creative studio or a collector's shelf and gets people talking. Have us build this concept, or bring your own idea and we'll sculpt and finish it as a one-off art figure.
settings.case_body: Designed as a concept art figure, this piece brings a bold idea into the room - ideal for crypto and tech offices that want art with attitude. We take a concept from sketch or render to a finished, displayable sculpture.
settings.case_quote: It's the first thing people notice in our office - everyone wants the story behind it.
settings.prov_p: The best concept art turns an idea into an object you can stand in front of. We specialise in taking a concept - yours or ours - and sculpting it into a finished, display-ready piece.
